parsed.message: Cestria, Borvane seeks a negotiated settlement to end this blockade and restore stability to the Ondar Marches. We recognize the current military balance and the costs war would impose on both our nations. We propose good-faith negotiations on a fair division of contested access, backed by verifiable commitments. Borvane is prepared to accept an international inspection regime and enter binding pledges in a public Commitment Ledger to ensure compliance. We believe a durable settlement now, before reinforcements arrive, serves both our strategic interests better than escalation. We await your proposal.

Cestria, Ardelia proposes a negotiated settlement to end this blockade immediately. We recognize the current military balance and the costs of conflict to both nations. We are prepared to accept a fair division of the contested access and to formalize our commitment through a public Commitment Ledger backed by a substantial bond held in neutral escrow. This demonstrates our good faith and our preference for a stable, verifiable agreement over the risks of escalation. We believe a settlement now serves both our interests better than the uncertainty ahead. We await your proposal.

Iskarel, Ardelia proposes a negotiated settlement to end this blockade. We recognize the current military balance and the costs of conflict to both nations. We are prepared to accept a fair division of the contested access and to formalize our commitment through a public Commitment Ledger backed by a substantial bond in neutral escrow. This demonstrates our good faith and our preference for a stable, verifiable agreement over the risks of escalation. We await your proposal for how to divide the 100 units. A swift resolution serves both our interests.

Hestmark, Lestovia proposes a fair settlement of this blockade crisis. We recognize the military balance favors you now, but both our nations face ruinous costs if war erupts. We propose accepting a division that reflects current realities while offering you certainty and avoiding the risks of escalation. We are prepared to formalize any agreement through the international inspection regime and a binding commitment ledger. Our goal is a stable, verifiable settlement that both sides can trust and honor. We await your proposal.

Ostrelia, Kelmora proposes a fair settlement of this blockade. We recognize the military balance favors you now, but we also see that reinforcements arrive soon. Rather than risk escalation and the costs of conflict, we propose a negotiated division that respects both nations' interests. We are prepared to commit publicly to honoring any agreed settlement, backed by a substantial bond held in neutral escrow. This demonstrates our good faith and our preference for a stable, lasting resolution over the uncertainty of military confrontation. We await your proposal.

Kelmora, Pervande proposes a fair settlement of this blockade crisis. We recognize the military balance today favors neither side decisively. We are prepared to negotiate a division of the contested access that reflects current realities and avoids the catastrophic costs of war to both our nations. We commit to good-faith negotiations and welcome an international inspection regime to verify any agreement. Our goal is a stable, mutually acceptable resolution that allows both nations to move forward. We await your proposal.

Dravonia, Jorvania seeks a negotiated settlement to end this blockade and restore stability to the region. We recognize the military balance today favors neither side decisively, and war carries unacceptable costs for both nations. We propose good-faith negotiations on a fair division of contested access to the Veyra Valley. Jorvania is prepared to commit publicly to any agreed settlement, backed by verifiable guarantees. We believe a durable peace serves both our peoples better than the escalating risks of military confrontation. Let us resolve this through dialogue.

Hestmark, Galdovia proposes a fair settlement of this blockade crisis. We recognize the military balance currently favors you, but we also see that reinforcements arriving in Period 2 will shift that balance significantly. Rather than risk escalation and the mutual costs of war, we propose a negotiated division that respects both nations' interests. We are prepared to commit publicly to honoring any agreed settlement, backed by a substantial bond held in neutral escrow. This demonstrates our good faith and provides you security. We believe a settlement now—before tensions rise further—serves both our peoples better than the uncertainty and destruction of conflict. We await your proposal.
